title: CDS-Skill log record
description: One JSONL line per stage. The envelope carries everything needed to reconstruct a run without the console transcript: which skill, index and config produced it, which model and decoding settings were in force, and a content hash of the exact signal packet. v0.1 stored only 'run id, input summary, score, decision, output', which cannot support the reproducibility claim in its own risk table.

record_id.description: Deterministic over (run_id, turn_id, stage, event_id, payload digest). Identical inputs therefore produce identical record ids, which is what makes the cross-run replication check in the test suite meaningful.

model.description: Supplied by the caller via --model/--provider/--temperature/--seed. The skill cannot observe the host model itself and does not pretend to.

payload.description: The stage output verbatim (detection, evaluation, command result or error detail).
